## Code Review

This pull request adds a comprehensive implementation plan for the 9709 FigureAsset precise crop production, detailing the architecture, execution policy, and a 16-step issue chain to move 858 visual-required rows to precise crop assets. The reviewer's feedback provides highly actionable improvements to the plan's steps, including ensuring lexicographical sorting of generated JSON arrays to prevent diff churn, checking file existence before hashing to avoid file system errors, using a unified normalization function for mixed string/object metadata to prevent stringification issues, handling missing or malformed critical artifacts gracefully in validation scripts, and expanding unit test coverage to explicitly test malformed-input guard paths and failure paths.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).
